messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] Canary deploy v2.3.1 reporting regression in us-west-2 (10% traffic). p95 latency +120ms vs baseline, error rate 3.2% (>1% threshold). Suggest rollback if not recovered in 5m. https://deploys.redwood/internal/1789998888 :warning:

jordan: I see it on the dashboard too. Traces show KV cache misses spiking around token 60-120.

maya: is this just canary or also hitting other regions?

deploy-bot: Canary only (us-west-2). No autoscale or infra churn detected in the window.

sam: who touched quant/kernel selection recently? We had a micro-change earlier this morning, right?

emily: I merged a quant tuning PR (PR #4123) at 07:12 UTC — small kernel fallback reordering.

ryan: oncall — what's our rollback criteria? SLO is p95 +50ms or error >1% sustained for 3m. We're past that. I'm +1 for rollback.

jordan: agree. Prefer manual rollback so we can pin and observe. Also disable feature flag `exp_quant_v2` while we investigate.

maya: plan: 1) flip FF off, 2) run deploy-bot rollback to v2.3.0, 3) pin dedicated pools, 4) monitor metrics for 15m. Ready to execute if folks +1.

sam: +1 from me. Notify CS/support after we confirm positive effect. No public comms unless it widens.

emily: I'll open a revert PR and add a changelog note "revert quant tuning - causes p95 regression".

jordan: also add a temporary scheduler pin on dedicated-prod-1 so autoscaler doesn't pull the bad release.

maya: executing now. Command: ```deploy-bot rollback --release v2.3.1 --target v2.3.0 --reason "canary latency regression"```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maya. Dry-run passed, applying rollback across canary replicas...

maya: rollback in progress — seeing pods restart in canary pool.

deploy-bot: Progress: canary replicas 10/10 rolled back, healthchecks OK.

maya: rollback complete. Monitoring metrics now. p95 trending back towards baseline.

jordan: confirmed on dashboards — p95 ~245ms (baseline 230-250), errors down to 0.4%. Good. Keep canary frozen, don't promote.

ryan: good containment. I'll file a postmortem and add the rollback decision, timelines, and remediation actions (test harness for quant kernels).

emily: PR opened to revert the quant change and tagged `chore/revert-quant-pr4123`. Adding steps to replicate in CI with longer sequence lengths.

sam: I'll notify CS/support and draft a short internal update. No customer-facing notice needed yet.

jordan: action items: 1) leave canary pinned to v2.3.0, 2) add regression test, 3) run canary with larger seq lengths, 4) postmortem.

maya: done pinning and FF off. Closing the alert once metrics are stable for 15m.

deploy-bot: Alert resolved (closed by maya).

sam: thanks everyone — marking this as executed and moving to follow-up ticket INC-789.

jordan: on the postmortem please list exact rollback command and time window, and whether the quant change should be reverted or tweaked.

emily: will include PR links and trace links.

maya: locking thread, will reopen if anything resurfaces. :white_check_mark:
